label: Enable equipment reads
help: Off by default. Prepare never connects; only Play in periodic mode or an explicit read opens the connection.

label: Protocol
help: Changing protocol also requires adapting the point definitions before Apply.

label: Acquisition at Play
help: On command waits for read/start. Periodic begins at Play in Active Runtime only.

label: Equipment endpoint
help: Modbus: tcp://host:502. OPC UA: opc.tcp://host:4840/path. Explicit port, no credentials or discovery.

label: Allow unencrypted equipment access
help: Required for Modbus TCP and OPC UA without security. Use only an explicitly trusted equipment network.

label: Modbus unit ID
help: 1–255. Broadcast unit 0 is refused. Register addresses are zero-based offsets.

label: OPC UA security
help: Sign and encrypt uses Basic256Sha256 with an exact pinned server certificate. No silent downgrade.

label: Client credentials in wallet
help: Secure OPC UA: wallet JSON with certificate_pem/private_key_pem and optional username/password. Clear this reference before selecting unencrypted access. Never paste private keys here.

label: Pinned public server certificate (PEM)
help: Paste the exact public certificate, not a private key. Certificate changes require review and a new Run.

label: Allowed points (JSON)
help: Array: Modbus {"id":"temp","area":"holding","address":0,"type":"uint16","scale":0.1,"unit":"C"}; OPC UA {"id":"temp","node_id":"ns=2;s=Temp","type":"float64","unit":"C"}. At most 64 points.

label: Minimum read interval (ms)
help: Bounds periodic and explicit reads; one request at a time, no catch-up burst.

label: Connection deadline (ms)
help: A stuck resolver or protocol handshake is terminated in the owned process.

label: Read deadline (ms)
help: Total deadline for all selected points, not a fresh allowance per register.

label: Observation expiry (ms)
help: Emit null with stale quality when a point is not successfully refreshed. Stop/disconnect also invalidates observations.

label: Automatic reconnect attempts
help: Only periodic acquisition retries; finite budget until an explicit start. No hidden SDK retries.

label: Reconnect delay (ms)
help: Fixed minimum pause between failed connection attempts.

label: Maximum batches per Run
help: Stop acquisition at the limit. A new Run is required to reset the count.

label: OPC UA client application URI
help: Must match a URI in the client certificate SAN; default urn:hackinvent:bloxsmith:industrial-read.

label: Maximum OPC UA source age (ms)
help: Reject old source timestamps even when a new network response arrives. Adjust for the device’s timestamp semantics.

label: Allowed source clock lead (ms)
help: A source timestamp too far in the future is unknown, not fresh.

label: Require OPC UA source timestamp
help: Missing source time invalidates the value. Modbus has no native sample timestamp and reports its age as unknown.
